messages:
alex: Quick FYI - discovered a parity bug: Node SDK JSON mode + auth-retry double-stringifies nested tool output, then schema validation fails in sampleapp.

sara: Oof. Does python do the same?

alex: No, python keeps nested objects. Node retry middleware stringifies bodies when enqueueing and doesn't parse on rehydrate. Example: validator receives "{\"task\":\"summarize\",\"result\":\"{\\\"score\\\":0.9}\"}" (result is a string).

mike: That's a parity bug. Quick mitigation: add post-validate hook in sampleapp to JSON.parse result when typeof === 'string'. Not ideal but unblocks onboarding.

alex: Created issue REDWOOD-ISSUE-1289 and added logs + repro branch.

sara: Plan for SDK fix?

mike: PR will avoid JSON.stringify for application/json bodies in the retry queue and add integration test that forces auth refresh during functioncall. Also add a CI parity smoke check against python.

devex-bot: Issue REDWOOD-ISSUE-1289 created: node-sdk retry queue double-serializes structured outputs - https://redwood/issues/1289

sara: I'll add a short note in the JSON-mode onboarding doc describing the temporary workaround so new users don't assume the model/schema is broken.

alex: Thanks team, will revert sampleapp workaround once the node-sdk PR lands. Closing thread for now.
